steps.instruction: Enter the main lobby of the ATC Building and walk straight past the reception desk.
Turn left at the elevator bank and locate Staircase A.
Go up the stairs to the 1st Floor.
Turn right exiting the staircase corridor and walk down the main hall.
The HOD Office (Room 105) is the second door on your left.
Enter the lobby, walk straight past reception, and turn right toward the east wing.
Go straight down the corridor past the seminar room.
Lab 101 is located directly at the end of the corridor on your right.
Enter the lobby and walk straight past the reception desk.
Take the main elevator or stairs on your left up to the 1st Floor.
Turn left when exiting the elevator corridor.
Lab 102 is the third room on your right, next to the faculty lounge.
Enter the building lobby and turn right toward the elevators.
Take the elevator to the 2nd Floor.
Turn left out of the elevator and walk down the corridor.
The AI/ML Lab (Room 204) is located on your right hand side.
Enter the building lobby and go up the main staircase on the left to the 1st Floor.
Walk straight into the west corridor.
The Networking Lab (Room 112) is the last door at the end of the hallway.
Enter the ATC building lobby and walk straight.
Take the stairs on your left to the 1st Floor.
Turn right out of the staircase and walk past Room 102.
The Database Lab (Room 106) is straight ahead.
Enter through the Golden Gate main arches and walk straight into the central courtyard.
Turn right at the statue and walk toward the admin wing entrance.
The Admin / HOD office is the first door on your left.
